workflow.description: A workflow with manages: vm, and its version: <id>@<M> or <id>@<M.m>.

hardware.description: Validated by the workflow's inputs schema, and passed to its OpenTofu stage.

network.description: Validated by the workflow's inputs schema, and passed to its OpenTofu stage.

inputs.description: Given to every stage of the workflow: as the OpenTofu variable inputs, and as extra vars to its Ansible stage. Validated by the workflow's inputs schema.

secrets.description: Extra vars filled from the variable store, for the workflow's Ansible stage. Only the step that runs the playbook receives them.

secretFiles.description: Extra vars holding the path of a private file with the store value, for tasks that copy a file.

schedules.description: Actions of the workflow to run on their own, at times in the lab's timezone.

action.description: setup, or an action of the workflow.

cron.description: Five fields: minute, hour, day of the month, month, day of the week.

address.description: Where an Ansible stage connects; by default the guest's static or reserved address.

user.description: The login of an Ansible stage.

sshKey.description: For a machine Octopushy did not create: an unencrypted OpenSSH private key, stored as a secret. Without it, Octopushy generates and uses its own key for this guest.

hostKey.description: The guest's public SSH host key, read through a trusted channel and stored by an operator. Octopushy never scans for it. Without it, a guest whose workflow's machine stage has hostKey: managed, on a host its installation lists under snippets.hosts, uses the key Octopushy generates and delivers; any other guest with Ansible work needs it.
